sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(om.month, rm.month) AS month,
  om.orders_placed,
  rm.returns_requested,
  CASE WHEN om.orders_placed > 0 THEN ROUND(rm.returns_requested * 100.0 / om.orders_placed, 1) ELSE NULL END AS return_rate_pct,
  rm.returns_refunded,
  rm.avg_days_requested_to_refunded,
  rm.median_days_requested_to_refunded,
  CASE WHEN rm.returns_requested > 0 THEN ROUND(rm.returns_rejected * 100.0 / rm.returns_requested, 1) ELSE NULL END AS returns_rejected_pct
FROM
  (SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', placed_at), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(*) AS orders_placed
   FROM orders
   WHERE placed_at >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND placed_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
   GROUP BY 1) om
FULL OUTER JOIN
  (SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', requested_at), '%Y-%m') AS month,
          count(*) AS returns_requested,
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'refunded') AS returns_refunded,
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'rejected') AS returns_rejected,
          ROUND(AVG(extract(epoch from (refunded_at - requested_at))/86400) FILTER (WHERE status = 'refunded' AND refunded_at IS NOT NULL), 1) AS avg_days_requested_to_refunded,
          ROUND(CAST(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch from (refunded_at - requested_at))/86400) FILTER (WHERE status = 'refunded' AND refunded_at IS NOT NULL) AS numeric), 1) AS median_days_requested_to_refunded
   FROM order_returns
   WHERE requested_at >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND requested_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
   GROUP BY 1) rm
ON om.month = rm.month
ORDER BY COALESCE(om.month, rm.month)
note: Return rate is an approximation (returns requested in month M / orders placed in month M), since a return in month M may relate to an order placed in an earlier month, as noted in the request. Orders-placed and returns-side columns are grained on their own respective timestamp (placed_at vs requested_at) per the brief, and the two series are combined via a full outer join on month so no month is dropped if one side has zero activity.
